normalization: Each asset is reduced to the source's geometry only: role=img, viewBox 0 0 24 24, title, and the path data (fill-rule preserved where the source declared it; together.ai's three disjoint subpaths merged into one path element). No color, style, or script content ships.

entries.reason: The family covers many compatible vendors (Ollama, OpenRouter, ...) - a single company mark would misidentify them. Per-connection preset marks carry the vendor identity instead. Text identity per asset-law rule 8.
